assemblies.citation: Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 BOM: every placed symbol in_bom/on_board, no DNP

loads.citation: Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 gen_symboles.py MSD1514: L1 pins 1(dot)-3 per msd1514.pdf p3; L2 pins 2-4, pin-2 dot assumed by symmetry (author: to verify on a real part)

switches.citation: Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 flyback.kicad_sch: Q1 drain SW_PRI on T1.3

synchronous_rectifier.citation: Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 flyback.kicad_sch: U12 VD=SW_SEC, VS=VOUT_N, VG to Q2 gate

circuit_decisions.citation: Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 flyback.kicad_sch (page 3): T1 secondary SW_SEC/VOUT_P is rectified by Q2, whose gate U12 drives (VD=SW_SEC, VS=VOUT_N); the primary switch Q1 and the synchronous rectifier Q2 are one flyback converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 flyback.kicad_sch (page 3): Out1 on VOUT_P/VOUT_N is the converter output connector; every part the walk reaches from it (C3, C4, C43, C44, D3, R9, R13) is the output stage of PRI-FLYBACK

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 5: J1 HV80_IN feeds Q3 (BSS127I, gate R26 on CS_GATE) and Q4 (MMBT2222 on CS_TOP/CS_EMIT), a linear current-limited bias feed into HV_BIAS, not a switching converter
Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 5: Q4 (MMBT2222 on CS_TOP/CS_EMIT) limits the current of the Q3 bias feed into HV_BIAS; with Q3 it is a linear stage, not a switching converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 4: U1 UCC27517 drives the primary switch Q1 gate from PWM_PRI_OUT; U12 UCC24612 senses SW_SEC and drives the synchronous rectifier Q2 — both are the converter's own

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 5: Q5 BSS127I with Q3/Q4 is the linear HV_BIAS feed the Q3/Q4 rejects describe; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 4: U3 ISO7710 digital isolator carries PWM_PRI_IN to PWM_PRI_OUT between control and primary domains; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 4: U5 PC817 optocoupler carries the enable EN_PRI_OUT between domains; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 4: U7 AMC0311R isolated amplifier senses VOUT_SENSE for the control loop; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 4: U8 AMC0311R isolated amplifier senses TEMP for the control loop; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 4: U9 AMC0302R isolated amplifier senses ISENSE_P for the control loop; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 5: U10 ISO7710 digital isolator carries PWM_BIAS_IN to the bias stage; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter

Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 5: U11 AMC0311R isolated amplifier senses BIAS_SENSE for the control loop; the control and sensing chain is outside this replay case, which reviews the converter
Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 2: Reg1 LM317M is a linear regulator of the control-side supply rails, outside this replay case, which reviews the converter
Nicolboy/KICAD-C2000-float-flyback@29fb9d9 page 2: Reg2 MCP1703-3302 is a linear regulator of the control-side supply rails, outside this replay case, which reviews the converter
